gloss_en: the aforementioned clouds (הָעֲנָנִים הַנַּ"ל) — the seven clouds of glory discussed in Likutey Moharan I:21 that form the covering (sekhakh) of the sukkah of divine influx; identified with the seven lamps of the menorah and with the mist (אֵד) that rises from the earth, and characterized as holy (kodesh), not receiving impurity
